summary: Iter76 legal/branding/policy hardening — frontend-only Playwright regression against the preview URL. 59/59 spec checks pass (57 direct + 2 case-insensitive re-verifications for the 'Last Updated: May 13, 2026' line, which renders uppercase via CSS text-transform). All four login pages (/admin, /pm, /shop, /hr) render 'Powered by ForgedOps™' below the form with no 'ForgedOps LLC' wording leaking into UI chrome.
critical_code_review_comments: ForgedOpsAttribution.jsx is a clean three-variant component with proper data-testids for each variant (global/login/admin) and a build-version stamp with both display + title-attribute (ISO timestamp). No issues.
Legal pages use semantic <h2> per section so screen readers and automated regression tooling can find each section by heading text — appreciated.

The 'Last Updated' line uses CSS text-transform:uppercase. Source-code stamps remain mixed-case ('May 13, 2026'); rendered DOM via innerText surfaces UPPERCASE. Future automated checks should use case-insensitive matching — this is a UI/QA tooling note, not a bug.

ops_manual.py / training_pdf.py were out of frontend test scope this iter; their 'LLC' usage is intentional per spec (legal ownership disclosures + classification stamps). PDF footer check is mentioned in the request but cannot be exercised through frontend-only testing — main agent's separate verification of PDF generation in iter74 still holds (footer reads 'Generated through MASCI HUB — Powered by ForgedOps™ | © 2026 ForgedOps™').
